text:
Natalie G: Quick pass needed on ApolloCloud hero tile + logo credits. Partner uploaded final art to Figma: https://figma.com/file/apollo-hero. Main asks: confirm logo lockup (white / dark bg), credit line copy, alt text, and marketplace CTA contrast. Need this by EOD for Monday marketplace publish.
Samir P: Thanks — putting on my radar. Can we get the quote attribution confirmed? Partner copy says 'Head of Infrastructure' but legal wants exact title. :thinking_face:
Jorge (design): I looked at Figma — two issues: 1) white lockup on hero crops badly at 320px, need slightly larger padding; 2) CTA color fails AA contrast on the dark background. I'll paste quick CSS we used:
```css
.logo { max-height: 48px; padding-right: 12px; }
.hero-cta { background-color: #0056d6; color: #ffffff; } /* fails AA at small text */
```
Maria L: For alt text, partner suggested "ApolloCloud logo" — can we use a slightly richer description: "ApolloCloud — managed GPU inference platform"? That helps site SEO and accessibility.
LegalBot: Partner sent signed quote consent doc but line 4 uses an informal title. We need the official title (e.g., "VP, Cloud Infrastructure") or permission to use the informal title. Ask partner ops to confirm.
PartnerOps: Looping in Apollo contact (cc: @apollopartner). They responded: "Preferred bylines: 'Alex Chen, VP Cloud Infrastructure' — confirmed." Also attached a high-res SVG with full-color and a reversed white version.
Natalie G: Great — Jorge can you push the padded lockup and swap CTA to the slightly darker indigo (#003fa6)? That should fix contrast. Samir, can you update the credit line to: "Partner: ApolloCloud — Alex Chen, VP Cloud Infrastructure" and add alt text Maria suggested?
Samir P: Will do. Quick Q: marketplace micro-tile has a 140x140 constraint — do we use reversed logo or the compact mark? Jorge?
Jorge (design): Use compact mark for 140x140. Export specs: SVG + 2x PNG @ 280x280 for retina. I'll upload exports to the same Figma frame.
Maria L: Also please add alt text to the asset upload metadata and include the short description: "High-performance inference platform for production LLMs".
LegalBot: Confirmed consent updated with official title. No legal blockers now. :white_check_mark:
Natalie G: Awesome. Final checklist: 1) Jorge exports updated lockups & CTA color; 2) Samir updates marketplace copy/credit; 3) Maria adds alt text and short desc; 4) PartnerOps confirms asset upload link in the thread. Ping me when done and I'll approve for publish. :rocket:
